record.file_problem: The supplied text contains the README and a truncated file listing, not the result-file contents. No specific benchmark outcomes can be read from it.
record.tranche_reason: The README describes refusal benchmarking of models identified as abliterated, which bears on practical removal, but it does not report the benchmark outcomes or describe a causal direction intervention.
record.gate_note: The README lists refusal, compliance, risk and utility metrics and states that results are stored in JSON files. The file listing shows those files exist, but their values are not available here; no behavioral-result rows can be extracted. The README does not report addition or causal ablation tests.
record.test_reason: The repo benchmarks two released abliterated checkpoints (Gemma 2 9B, Mistral NeMo 12B) against their aligned bases on refusal and utility. Those results would bear on V2 in a new safety/bias setting. However, the supplied text has only the README and a file listing, so no outcome can be read. T3 rather than T2 because it evaluates third-party abliterated models rather than performing or varying the ablation.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate. The README states the aim of studying how abliteration and parametric censorship affect LLM safety and bias. It states no outcome-based conclusion.
record.recipe_differences: The README names abliterated checkpoints and benchmark scripts, but does not specify how the abliteration was produced or whether it used the original difference-in-means direction.
record.problems: The supplied material does not include the JSON results, so the described refusal and utility measures cannot be assessed; the README does not state uncertainty estimates.
record.rows_left_out: No behavioral rows extracted: the README supplies no outcome values, and the listed JSON result and evaluation files are not readable in the supplied text.

How the abliteration was made is not stated, and whether the edit used the original direction is unknown. The refusal and utility outcomes are not visible in the supplied text.
No jailbreak mechanism or adversarial training is studied.
No comparison of one direction against multi-direction or cone accounts.

record.verdict_notes: This is a master's thesis data repository (UGR, 2026), not peer reviewed. The sample is small: 25 main prompts and 27 bias prompts per model, scored by an automatic rubric, with no uncertainty reported. Only two of the nine models are abliterated; the Dolphin models are uncensored by fine-tuning and do not bear on the direction claim. No verdict is possible until the JSON results are read.
